description: Fix a BinaryHeap-based priority queue that breaks ties by comparing payload strings directly (no FIFO guarantee) into an insertion-order-stable one
prompts: src/lib.rs's StablePriorityQueue wraps a std::collections::BinaryHeap<Item> whose Ord impl compares ONLY by priority (via Reverse for min-heap behavior) - ties between equal-priority items fall back to comparing nothing else, which BinaryHeap does not define as any particular pop order. Fix it so that: (1) items with a lower priority number come out first, and (2) items with EQUAL priority always come out in the order they were originally pushed (FIFO) - add an explicit monotonically increasing insertion-order field to Item and include it in the Ord/PartialOrd comparison as the tiebreaker (remember BinaryHeap is a MAX-heap, so wrap the whole comparison key in std::cmp::Reverse or negate appropriately to get min-priority-first, FIFO-tiebreak behavior).
name: add_rust_stable_priority_queue
